svg.aria-label: Locator map of St Thérèse's Normandy: Alençon, where she was born on 2 January 1873; Semallé, where she was nursed by Rose Taillé in 1873–74; and Lisieux, home of Les Buissonnets and the Carmel from 1877 until her death in 1897, with Caen, Bayeux, Le Havre, Trouville, Rouen, Évreux and Le Mans. An inset shows the area within France, with Paris and Rome.
